location_flow_orchestrator.name: Location Flow Orchestrator
location_flow_orchestrator.purpose: Orchestrates complete location workflow from GPS acquisition to map visualization with automatic journey progression
location_flow_orchestrator.concern: Complete location data pipeline coordination with real-time visualization

flow.does: validatePhase → updateMapLocation → calculateProgress → handleBusTracking → updateUI → checkTransitions
flow.out: Visual user location on map + automatic journey progression + UI updates

talks_to.map_location_updater: renders user location on map immediately

behavior: asynchronous progress calculation to avoid blocking
hybrid bus tracking mode switching based on step type

outputs.name: visualUpdate
outputs.description: Updated user location on map + journey progress in UI

location_flow_orchestrator.flowNotes: CRITICAL ISSUE: The map update happens but may not be visible due to layer ordering or rendering problems in Mapbox

map_location_updater.name: Map Location Updater
map_location_updater.purpose: Bridges location updates to MapManager for immediate visual feedback
map_location_updater.concern: Location visualization coordination between app logic and map rendering

flow.out: User location rendered on map as blue circle

behavior: uses Riverpod provider to access MapManager
includes error handling for null MapManager

dependencies.purpose: actual map rendering and layer management

map_location_updater.flowNotes: Bridge function that connects app state to map visualization - POTENTIAL ISSUE HERE

map_visualization_pipeline.name: Map Visualization Pipeline
map_visualization_pipeline.purpose: Renders user location as visual circle on Mapbox map with error handling
map_visualization_pipeline.concern: Simplified user location visualization without complex debugging

flow.out: Blue circle marker on map at user location

behavior: uses simplified source management (no complex debugging)
handles source existence with update-or-create pattern
map_visualization_pipeline.flowNotes: CRITICAL: This is where the visual issue likely occurs - the source updates but visibility may be impacted

condition_validator.name: Map Rendering Condition Validator
condition_validator.purpose: Validates map readiness and correct app phase for location rendering
condition_validator.concern: Pre-render validation to prevent rendering errors
behavior: ensures mapboxMap instance is not null
returns early if conditions not met
condition_validator.flowNotes: Gate function that prevents rendering in wrong conditions - POTENTIAL ISSUE if phase is incorrect

mapbox_source_manager.name: Mapbox Source and Layer Manager
mapbox_source_manager.purpose: Manages Mapbox data source lifecycle and layer creation for user location
mapbox_source_manager.concern: Mapbox SDK interface for source/layer management

flow.out: Active Mapbox source with visual layer

behavior: updates existing source with new GeoJSON data
creates new source + CircleLayer if missing
mapbox_source_manager.flowNotes: KEY AREA: This directly interfaces with Mapbox SDK - source of potential rendering issues

circle_layer_creator.name: User Location Circle Layer Creator
circle_layer_creator.purpose: Creates blue circle layer with specific styling for user location visualization
circle_layer_creator.concern: Visual layer configuration and styling for user location

flow.out: Styled blue circle layer visible on map

behavior: removes existing layer to prevent conflicts
applies blue color (0xFF2196F3) with white border
sideEffects: registers layer and source for tracking
circle_layer_creator.flowNotes: DEEPEST LEAF: This is where the actual visual element gets created - if map not showing user location, issue is likely here or in layer ordering
